summary: A simple mobile app called Viral Math App that teaches students the mathematics behind viral Instagram reels. Features three calculators: Engagement Calculator, Growth Simulator, and Decay Simulator. Dark theme design with a Gen Z aesthetic — bold visuals, trendy typography, vibrant gradients, and modern social media energy.
architectural_notes: Mobile app (simple single-page or tabbed layout) targeting students; no backend required — all calculations are client-side

existing_features.title: Create an Engagement Calculator screen where the user enters Views, Likes, Comments, and Shares as numeric inputs, then taps a 'Calculate' button. The app computes Engagement Rate = (Likes + Comments + Shares) / Views × 100 and displays the result formatted as a percentage (e.g., '4.75%'). Show a friendly error message if Views is zero or any field is empty.

Create a Growth Simulator screen where the user enters Initial Viewers, Shares Per Person, and Rounds as numeric inputs, then taps a 'Simulate' button. The app computes Total Reach = Initial × (Shares ^ Rounds) and displays the result as a formatted whole number. Show a friendly error message if any field is empty or invalid.

Create a Decay Simulator screen where the user enters Peak Views, Decay Rate (a decimal between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.85), and Days as numeric inputs, then taps a 'Simulate' button. The app computes Remaining Views = Peak × (Decay Rate ^ Days) and displays the result as a formatted whole number. Show a friendly error message if any field is empty or invalid.

Implement a tabbed or card-based navigation layout that lets users switch between the three tools: Engagement Calculator, Growth Simulator, and Decay Simulator. Each section should include a brief one-line educational description explaining what the math models (e.g., 'Measures how much your audience interacts with a reel.').

Apply a consistent dark-theme visual design across the entire app. Use a dark background (near-black), high-contrast text (white or light grey), accent colors in warm tones (e.g., orange or magenta to evoke social media energy), large easy-to-tap buttons, clearly readable result cards with prominent font size, and a clean mobile-first layout with generous spacing between elements.

Redesign the overall app visual identity to be Gen Z-native: replace the current color scheme with a vibrant neon/pastel gradient palette (e.g., electric purple, hot pink, neon green, cyan), use a bold display font (e.g., Space Grotesk or similar) for headings and result values, and add subtle micro-animations (pulse, bounce, or scale-in) on button interactions and result reveals.

Update the tab navigation bar to use a pill-style or floating bottom-bar design with gradient-filled active state indicators and emoji icons next to each tab label (e.g., 📊 Engagement, 🚀 Growth, 📉 Decay) to give it a social-media-app feel.

Redesign all input fields and the Calculate/Simulate buttons with a Gen Z aesthetic: inputs should have glowing neon borders on focus, and action buttons should use bold gradient fills (e.g., pink-to-purple or cyan-to-green) with rounded pill shapes and all-caps or bold label text.

Revamp the hero section and app header with a bold gradient headline, a short punchy tagline using Gen Z slang (e.g., 'Do the math. Go viral. No cap.'), and a dynamic gradient or glassmorphism background effect to make the app feel like a modern social media tool.

Update the ResultCard component with a glassmorphism card style (frosted glass background with a subtle neon border glow), display the result value in a large, bold, gradient-colored font, and show a fun contextual emoji alongside the result label (e.g., 🔥 for high engagement, 📈 for growth).

Save the uploaded logo image (image.png) as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png and display it in the app header/hero section in App.tsx, replacing or complementing the current text-based branding. The logo should be sized appropriately for mobile (e.g., height 56–72px), centered or left-aligned in the header, and styled to blend with the existing glassmorphism dark background without a visible white background box.

Increase the logo image size in the app header in App.tsx. The logo (displayed from frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png) should be enlarged to a height of approximately 80–100px (up from the current 56–72px range), while remaining centered or left-aligned and blending with the glassmorphism header background without a visible white box.

Add two new informational pages/screens to the app accessible via the existing tab/navigation system or a new navigation entry: (1) a 'How It Works' page that explains the math formulas behind each tool (Engagement Rate, Viral Growth, Decay) with simple visual breakdowns and Gen Z-friendly copy, and (2) a 'Tips & Tricks' page with short actionable advice on growing Instagram Reels (e.g., best posting times, content hooks, hashtag strategies), styled consistently with the existing dark Gen Z aesthetic.

In the app header in App.tsx, display the text 'Understand Virality Through Mathematics' directly beside the logo image (frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png). The tagline should be placed to the right of the logo, styled to match the existing Gen Z dark aesthetic — use a gradient or light-colored font consistent with the current header typography, appropriate font size for mobile readability (e.g., text-sm to text-base), and ensure the logo + tagline are horizontally aligned and centered or left-aligned within the glassmorphism header.
